title.zh: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion
title.en: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion

current_state.zh: Brazilian market infrastructure operator CSD BR has begun recording ownership of selected BTG Pactual investment funds on the public XRP Ledger as a real-time verification layer alongside its official database, with plans to explore direct issuance and trading of assets such as real-estate and agribusiness receivables.
